answer_1.quote: Finally, the response generation module produces a client's utterance using a turn-by-turn generation approach... Our framework comprises state transition, action selection, information selection, and response generation modules.

answer_2.quote: Our method outperforms most of the baselines... turn-level evaluation which involves using ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L as well as BERTScore. We also compute the Spearman's correlation between the receptivity scores of simulated clients and real clients.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4 to perform entailment assessment in a few-shot manner... The GPT-4 annotations achieve high accuracy rates... and are used to automatically evaluate consistency of generated profile components.

answer_4.quote: We employ four of our co-authors, who are experts in psychology and experienced in MI counseling, as annotators... Each score ranges from 1 (low consistency) to 5 (high consistency).
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated profile components (persona, beliefs, motivation, plan) and realism on a 1-5 Likert scale; also annotated receptivity levels using a 1-3 scale.
